headline: Week 7: none of your players are in the Thursday game, Hockenson and Jefferson practiced fully, but you still need a kicker and an RB before Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific.
alerts: No one on your roster plays Thursday (Patriots at Bears, 5:15 PM Pacific). Bears RB Kyle Monangai is inactive, so Roschon Johnson gets work if you grabbed him.
You still have no kicker. Add Chad Ryland or Jake Bates before Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific, or the K slot scores zero.
Brian Robinson (hamstring) went from limited to no practice Thursday. Do not count on him at RB2. Add Kendre Miller (Sun 6:30 AM Pacific lock) or Dameon Pierce.
Hockenson (concussion) practiced fully Wednesday and Thursday and is on track to play Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Keep him over Ferguson.
Jefferson (ankle) upgraded to full practice Thursday. Start him.
Josh Jacobs is set to debut Sunday 1:25 PM Pacific, so Lloyd is a weak flex. Golden (shoulder) was limited but LaFleur says he will play.
Breece Hall (quad) returned as a limited participant Thursday. Still a stash until Friday status, Jets play Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific.
Sleeper could not be reached this run, so the roster is from an earlier run. Confirm your waiver claims and lineup in the app.

ARI.note: Vs. Denver Sunday 1:05 PM Pacific. Broncos -4.5, total 43.5, Arizona about 19.5 implied. RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) may return.

GB.note: At Detroit Sunday 1:25 PM Pacific. Lions -3, total 52.5, Packers about 24.75 implied. Jacobs expected to debut, Love full, Golden and Watson limited but will play.

DET.note: Vs. Green Bay Sunday 1:25 PM Pacific. Lions -3, total 52.5, about 27.75 implied. Back from bye.

ATL.note: Vs. San Francisco Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. 49ers -4.5, total 50.5. Brian Robinson (hamstring) did not practice Thursday.

MIN.note: Vs. Indianapolis Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Vikings -6.5, total 41.5. Hockenson, Jefferson, Addison and Mason all practiced fully Thursday. Colts TE Tyler Warren and CB Sauce Gardner did not practice.

IND.note: At Minnesota Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Colts about 18 implied. Sauce Gardner doubtful, Tyler Warren questionable.

NYJ.note: Vs. Miami Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Jets -4.5, total 38.5. Breece Hall limited Thursday. Dolphins QB Malik Willis (thumb) full.

DAL.note: At Philadelphia Monday 5:15 PM Pacific. Cowboys -5.5, total 44.5. Eagles without Hurts, Barkley still not cleared.

PHI.note: Vs. Dallas Monday 5:15 PM Pacific. Hurts on IR, Barkley (hamstring) TBD, Dameon Pierce handled every RB carry in Week 6.

WAS.note: Bye week. McLaurin feared to have a season-ending knee injury.

CHI.note: Vs. New England Thursday 5:15 PM Pacific. Bears inactives include RB Kyle Monangai and QB Case Keenum.

NE.note: At Chicago Thursday 5:15 PM Pacific. Patriots inactives include CB Carlton Davis and C Ben Brown.
